_note: Codes only. Duty rates are published only where verified on a real shipment; everything else renders as 'Request'. status=verified means the code was used on a quoted order; status=working means it is our classification pending confirmation on the exact specification. National lines below the 6-digit level depend on material, fibre or capacity, so treat them as the working line.
